sources.entry: Claumon by fabioconcina - Claude Code dashboard for Pro/Max users: live rate-limit gauges, calibrated usage forecasts, session costs, memory browser. Single binary, zero config.

summary.one_liner: Claumon is a local, single-binary web dashboard for Claude Code users that shows live rate-limit gauges, calibrated usage forecasts, session costs, and a browser for the memory files Claude Code keeps under ~/.claude.
summary.what_it_does: Runs a local HTTP server (default port 3131) that serves an embedded single-page dashboard. It pulls live session, weekly, and per-model utilization from the Claude OAuth usage API, using credentials from ~/.claude/.credentials.json or the OS credential store. It parses Claude Code session JSONL files for per-session token and cost breakdowns, and stores daily aggregates in SQLite for trends over a selectable 7 to 90 day window. It produces session forecasts (projected utilization at reset with an 80% credible interval and ETA to threshold) from a statistical model the README says is published as MODEL.pdf. It also includes a memory-file browser with health scores, a relationship graph, and recoverable deletion, plus running-process control. Updates are pushed to the browser over SSE.
use_cases: monitor Claude Code rate limits in real time
forecast when Claude usage will hit its limit
track Claude Code costs per session over weeks
browse and clean up Claude Code memory files
run a local usage dashboard as a background service
view Claude Code usage from a VS Code status bar
notable: Live rate-limit gauges measured from the Claude OAuth usage API rather than estimated from logs
Forecasts from an empirical-Bayes model with an 80% credible interval, documented in a published MODEL.pdf
Single binary with zero config; no Node, Python, or build step needed to run
Background service install for macOS LaunchAgent, Linux systemd user unit, and Windows Startup folder
Release binaries include SHA-256 checksums, SPDX SBOMs, and GitHub build-provenance attestations
caveats: Live API gauges need Claude credentials; without them only session tracking works
Listens on IPv4 loopback only; remote access requires an SSH tunnel or authenticated reverse proxy, and a proxy may need allowed_hosts configured
Windows binary may be blocked by Defender and needs manual unblocking
keywords: see how much claude i have left
